class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        cin = spec.in_channels
        n = len(spec.footprints)
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COLH, 1), nn.GroupNorm(G, COLH), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COLH, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.e1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.n1 = nn.GroupNorm(G, W)
        self.d1 = nn.Conv2d(W, D, 3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.nd1 = nn.GroupNorm(G, D)
        self.d2 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 3, stride=2, padding=1)
        self.nd2 = nn.GroupNorm(G, D)
        self.gl = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.u1 = nn.Conv2d(D, D, 1)
        self.u0 = nn.Conv2d(D, W, 1)
        self.nu = nn.GroupNorm(G, W)
        c = COL + W
        self.hproj = nn.Conv2d(c, PROJ, 1)
        self.wins = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(PROJ, HID, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(n)])
        self.inter = nn.Conv2d(c, n, 1)
        self.tbias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))
        gdim = 2 * c + D
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(gdim, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(gdim, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv2d, nn.Linear)):
                init_layer(m, math.sqrt(2))
        for m in self.outs:
            init_layer(m, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.inter, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.done_head, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.value_head[2], 1.0)

        c0 = self.col(obs)
        e = F.relu(self.n1(self.e1(c0)))
        a = F.relu(self.nd1(self.d1(e)))
        b = F.relu(self.nd2(self.d2(a)))
        g = F.relu(self.gl(b.mean((2, 3))))
        b_up = F.interpolate(b, size=(a.shape[2], a.shape[3]), mode='nearest')
        a2 = F.relu(self.u1(a + b_up) + g[:, :, None, None])
        a_up = F.interpolate(a2, size=(e.shape[2], e.shape[3]), mode='nearest')
        f = F.relu(e + self.nu(self.u0(a_up)))
        h = torch.cat([c0, f], dim=1)
        p = F.relu(self.hproj(h))
        res = []

            res.append(out(F.relu(win(p))))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1) + self.inter(h) + self.tbias.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
        place = s.flatten(1)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3)), g], dim=1)
        gg = self.glob(pooled)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(pooled).squeeze(1)

D = 48
HEADS = 4
PROJ = 32
HID = 24
G = 4


def init_layer(m, gain):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    if m.bias is not None:
        nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, 2 * d)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(2 * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, n, d = x.shape
        hd = d // self.heads
        q, k, v = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(b, n, self.heads, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.ff2(F.relu(self.ff1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, gdim, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        n = len(self.fps)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.foot = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * proj, hid, 1, bias=False) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.inter = nn.Conv2d(c, n, 1)
        self.tbias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), foot, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.foot, self.mix, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = p, p
            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(foot(q) + mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1) + self.inter(f) + self.tbias.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
        return s.flatten(1)

        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COLH, 1), nn.GroupNorm(G, COLH), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COLH, D, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, D, spec.Y, spec.X))
        self.block = Block(D, HEADS)
        c = 2 * D
        gdim = 2 * c
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(gdim, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.head = FootHead(c, 64, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(gdim, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv2d, nn.Linear)):
                init_layer(m, math.sqrt(2))
        for m in self.block.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        for m in self.head.outs:
            init_layer(m, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.head.inter, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.done_head, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.value_head[2], 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        c0 = self.col(obs)
        t = (c0 + self.pos).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        t = self.block(t)
        a = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        h = torch.cat([c0, a], dim=1)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        place = self.head(h, g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(pooled).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

    return m

    def __init__(self, c, dil):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.GroupNorm(G, c)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=dil, dilation=dil)
        self.n2 = nn.GroupNorm(G, c)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.c1(F.relu(self.n1(x)))
        h = self.c2(F.relu(self.n2(h)))
        return x + h


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, gdim, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        n = len(self.fps)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.foot = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        self.anchor = nn.Conv2d(c, 1, 1)
        self.tbias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), foot, mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.foot, self.mix, self.outs):

        logits = torch.cat([lp, F.logsigmoid(d)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(pooled).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'lr': 1e-3, 'n_envs': 256, 'rollout_len': 32, 'n_minibatches': 32, 'ppo_epochs': 2, 'ent_coef': 0.01, 'gamma': 0.99, 'gae_lambda': 0.95, 'clip_eps': 0.2}

COLH = 96
D = 64
HT = 64
HC = 96
BLOCKS = 2
PROJ = 32
HID = 16
G = 4


def init_layer(m, gain):
    nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight, gain)
    if m.bias is not None:
        nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
    return m


class MixBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n, d, ht, hc):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.t1 = nn.Linear(n, ht)
        self.t2 = nn.Linear(ht, n)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.c1 = nn.Linear(d, hc)
        self.c2 = nn.Linear(hc, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.n1(x).transpose(1, 2)
        y = self.t2(F.gelu(self.t1(y))).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + y
        x = x + self.c2(F.gelu(self.c1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.foot = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, gb=None):
        p = self.proj(f)
        if gb is not None:
            p = p + gb[:, :, None, None]
        p = F.relu(p)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), foot, out in zip(self.fps, self.foot, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(foot(q))))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1)


class DenseHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, y, x, n_out, ch, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, ch, 1)
        self.l1 = nn.Linear(ch * y * x, hid)
        self.l2 = nn.Linear(hid, n_out)

    def forward(self, f):
        return self.l2(F.relu(self.l1(F.relu(self.proj(f)).flatten(1))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        cin = spec.in_channels
        n = len(spec.footprints)
        N = spec.Y * spec.X
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COLH, 1), nn.GroupNorm(G, COLH), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COLH, D, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, N, D))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([MixBlock(N, D, HT, HC) for _ in range(BLOCKS)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        c = 2 * D
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(64, PROJ)
        self.head = FootHead(c, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.inter = nn.Conv2d(c, n, 1)
        self.anchor = nn.Conv2d(c, 1, 1)
        self.tbias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))
        self.dense = DenseHead(c, spec.Y, spec.X, spec.n_actions, 8, 256)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv2d, nn.Linear)):
                init_layer(m, math.sqrt(2))
        for m in self.blocks.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        for m in self.head.outs:
            init_layer(m, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.inter, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.anchor, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.dense.l2, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.done_head, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.value_head[2], 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        c0 = self.col(obs)
        t = c0.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        a = self.nf(t).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        h = torch.cat([c0, a], dim=1)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        s = self.head(h, self.gproj(g)) + self.inter(h) + self.anchor(h) + self.tbias.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
        logits = torch.cat([s.flatten(1), self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + self.dense(h)
        return logits, self.value_head(pooled).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

    return Net(spec)

        super().__init__()
        n = len(footprints)
        span = max(max(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints)
        self.k = span + 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.win = nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, self.k)
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n, hid) * 0.1)
        self.shift = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n, hid) * 0.1)
        self.wout = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n, hid) * (0.01 / math.sqrt(hid)))
        self.bout = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))

    def forward(self, f):
        p = F.relu(self.proj(f))
        k = self.k
        q = F.pad(p, (1, k - 2, 1, k - 2))
        a = self.win(q).unsqueeze(1)
        h = F.relu(a * (1.0 + self.scale[None, :, :, None, None]) + self.shift[None, :, :, None, None])
        return (h * self.wout[None, :, :, None, None]).sum(2) + self.bout[None, :, None, None]


class DenseHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, y, x, n_out, ch, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, ch, 1)
        self.l1 = nn.Linear(ch * y * x, hid)
        self.l2 = nn.Linear(hid, n_out)

    def forward(self, f):
        return self.l2(F.relu(self.l1(F.relu(self.proj(f)).flatten(1))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        cin = spec.in_channels + 2
        n = len(spec.footprints)
        N = spec.Y * spec.X
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COLH, 1), nn.GroupNorm(G, COLH), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COLH, D, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, N, D))
        self.mixer = MixBlock(N, D, HT, HC)
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.cv = nn.Conv2d(D, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.cn = nn.GroupNorm(G, W)
        c = 2 * D + W
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(64, PROJ)
        self.fhead = FootHead(c, spec.footprints, PROJ, FHID)
        self.film = FilmHead(c, spec.footprints, MPROJ, MHID)
        self.inter = nn.Conv2d(c, n, 1)
        self.anchor = nn.Conv2d(c, 1, 1)
        self.tbias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))
        self.dense = DenseHead(c, spec.Y, spec.X, spec.n_actions, 8, 128)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))
        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, (nn.Conv2d, nn.Linear)):
                init_layer(m, math.sqrt(2))
        for m in self.mixer.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(m.weight)
                nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        for m in self.fhead.outs:
            init_layer(m, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.inter, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.anchor, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.dense.l2, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.done_head, 0.01)
        init_layer(self.value_head[2], 1.0)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        c0 = self.col(add_coords(obs))
        t = self.mixer(c0.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos)
        a = self.nf(t).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        f = F.relu(self.cn(self.cv(c0)))
        h = torch.cat([c0, a, f], dim=1)
        pooled = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        s = self.fhead(h, self.gproj(g)) + self.film(h) + self.inter(h) + self.anchor(h) + self.tbias.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
        logits = torch.cat([s.flatten(1), self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + self.dense(h)
        return logits, self.value_head(pooled).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

    b = obs.shape[0]
